title: First steps
instructions: Each command ends with a ; and they run in order, from top to bottom. Drive up to the corner, turn with turnRight(), and drive on to the X.
note: Anything after // is a comment. The rover skips it; it's a note for people.
hint: Count the cells on each straight part: 4 up, then 4 to the right. Put each command on its own line. Spelling and capital letters matter, so Forward(4) and turnright() won't work.
